messages.subject: Problems with gl.filter.hamming
parts:
Hi all,

Is someone else having problems recently with the gl.filter.hamming function?

I'm re-filtering a dataset of ~80,000 SNPs (dart data, imported as genlight using gl.read.dart). I started filtering by call.rate and reproducibility.
I used to run locally on my computer in Rstudio and it used to take around 2 days to run gl.filter.hamming in the same dataset. Now it is taking much longer, even using the Rstudio AI, and locally is not even running because o memory limits.

Does anyone have a suggestion on what can be happening?

Thank you!
Julia
